limitations: Zoom general-audience apps require a Zoom App Review and security audit before publishing to the Zoom App Marketplace. Unpublished apps can only be installed by the developer's account.

assumptions: Developer has active Zoom Pro or Business account
Building user-managed OAuth app with meeting:read and meeting:write scopes

externalWait.publishedRange: Instant for development inside developer account; 1–3 weeks for Zoom Marketplace review

prerequisites.text: Zoom account with Marketplace developer access permissions

steps.title: Create an OAuth App on Zoom Marketplace
steps.instructions: Log in to the Zoom App Marketplace at `https://marketplace.zoom.us/develop/create`. Under 'General App', select 'Create'. Enter your app name, choose whether your app is user-managed or admin-managed, and toggle 'Would you like to publish this app on Zoom App Marketplace?'.
steps.completionCheck: Zoom App dashboard created with Credentials tab available.

steps.title: Configure Redirect & Allow Lists
steps.instructions: Under 'App Credentials', locate 'Redirect URL for OAuth' and add your callback URL (e.g. `https://app.example.com/api/auth/callback/zoom`). In 'OAuth allow list', add any additional redirect host domains. Zoom requires strict HTTPS matching for production.
steps.completionCheck: Redirect URL and allow list configured.

steps.title: Select Scopes & Save Credentials
steps.instructions: Navigate to the 'Scopes' tab. Click 'Add Scopes' and select necessary permissions like `meeting:read` and `meeting:write`. Copy your Client ID and Client Secret from the App Credentials tab into your server environment variables (`ZOOM_CLIENT_ID` and `ZOOM_CLIENT_SECRET`).

steps.title: Handle Token Exchange with Basic Auth Header
steps.instructions: Direct users to `https://zoom.us/oauth/authorize?response_type=code&client_id={CLIENT_ID}&redirect_uri={REDIRECT_URI}`. Exchange the code at `https://zoom.us/oauth/token` with `grant_type=authorization_code&code={CODE}&redirect_uri={REDIRECT_URI}`. Zoom requires HTTP Basic Auth header: `Authorization: Basic Base64(CLIENT_ID:CLIENT_SECRET)`.
steps.completionCheck: HTTP 200 returned with access_token and refresh_token.

claims.text: Zoom apps are created on the Zoom App Marketplace at https://marketplace.zoom.us/develop/create.
Zoom enforces exact redirect URL and OAuth allow list matching with HTTPS requirements.
Zoom applications use Client ID and Client Secret for authenticated API requests.
Zoom token endpoint requires HTTP Basic authentication header constructed from Base64-encoded Client ID and Secret.
